title: Husain baat rahe hai nijaat le jao
body:
Husain baat rahe hai nijaat le jao
Husain baa'nt rahe hai, nijaat le jao
Batool baa'nt rahi hai, nijaat le jao
Husain baa'nt rahe hai, nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch aansuo'n ke ewaz kayenaat le jao
Batool baategi sadqa hussain ka is raat
samet sakte ho jitna wo saath le jao
Ye karbala hai ye mojiznuma ki basti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kafan mein is ke lapeto hayaat le jao
Jo aaj tak na mila ho tumhe khuda ki qasam
wo aake teesri shabaa'n ki raat le jao
Kahenge matami halqo se log mehshar mein
<<DIVIDER>>
hume husain ki jannat mein saath le jao
Hai jisme baara(12) imamo ke naam likhe hue
lahad mein saath islaamiyaat le jao
author: Mir Hassan Mir
